description: Small hand-written sample set in a TruthfulQA/FEVER-style format for measuring DETECTION performance. label SUPPORTED = the claim is backed by the knowledge base; NOT_SUPPORTED = the claim is false or absent from the knowledge base (the system should flag it).

samples.claim: Paris is the capital of France.
samples.label: SUPPORTED

samples.claim: Canberra is the capital city of Australia.
samples.label: SUPPORTED

samples.claim: Sydney is the capital of Australia.
samples.label: NOT_SUPPORTED

samples.claim: At standard atmospheric pressure water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
samples.label: SUPPORTED

samples.claim: Water boils at 70 degrees Celsius at sea level.
samples.label: NOT_SUPPORTED

samples.claim: The Great Wall of China is not visible to the unaided eye from space.
samples.label: SUPPORTED

samples.claim: The Great Wall of China is the only man-made object visible from the Moon.
samples.label: NOT_SUPPORTED

samples.claim: Python was created by Dennis Ritchie in 1984.
samples.label: NOT_SUPPORTED

samples.claim: The Transformer architecture was introduced in the paper Attention Is All You Need in 2017.
samples.label: SUPPORTED

samples.claim: The first Moon landing took place on 20 July 1969 during Apollo 11.
samples.label: SUPPORTED

samples.claim: The first Moon landing took place in 1972 during the Apollo 13 mission.
samples.label: NOT_SUPPORTED

samples.claim: The adult human body normally contains 206 bones.
samples.label: SUPPORTED

samples.claim: The adult human body contains 315 bones.
samples.label: NOT_SUPPORTED

samples.claim: The population of Hyderabad was exactly 11.2 million people in 2024.
samples.label: NOT_SUPPORTED

samples.claim: Ollama runs open-weight language models locally and exposes an HTTP server on port 11434.
samples.label: SUPPORTED
